text: Given valid X-3CX-Base-URL/Client-Id/Client-Secret headers, When calling 3cx_test_connection, Then it returns {status: ok, pbx_fqdn, checked_endpoint}
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_test_connection_tool_reports_ok -> PASSED (33 passed total, uv run pytest, 2026-11-04). Mocked 3CX transport: POST /connect/token -> {access_token}, GET /xapi/v1/Defs$top=1 -> value:[...]; asserts {status: ok, pbx_fqdn, checked_endpoint: /xapi/v1/Defs}.

text: Given any one of the three required credential headers is missing, When calling any tool, Then the response is HTTP 401 naming the missing header, not HTTP 500
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_middleware.py::test_missing_credential_header_returns_401 (5 parametrized cases: no headers, each single header present, and a placeholder-value secret) -> all PASSED. Each asserts HTTP 401 and required_headers == the 3 X-3CX-* header names.

text: Given valid credentials, When calling 3cx_list_extensions with a name filter, Then only matching extensions are returned, paginated with count/page/has_more/next_page/offset/next_offset
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_list_extensions_filters_and_paginates -> PASSED. Asserts $filter="FirstName eq 'Example'", $top/$skip sent correctly, and count/has_more/next_offset computed from a 5-row mocked page.

text: Given valid credentials, When calling 3cx_get_extension with an id that does not exist, Then a not_found error envelope is returned instead of raising
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_get_extension_not_found_envelope -> PASSED. Mocked /xapi/v1/Defs(999) returns 404; asserts result == {error: {code: not_found, ...}} instead of an exception.

text: Given valid credentials, When calling 3cx_list_queues then 3cx_get_queue with one of the returned ids, Then the queue directory round-trips the same way as extensions (same pagination and not_found shape)
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_list_and_get_queue -> PASSED. threecx_list_queues then threecx_get_queue round-trip the same mocked record.

text: Active calls are visible through the MCP tool
steps: On a real 3CX PBX, place a live call so at least one active call exists
Call 3cx_list_active_calls with valid headers for that PBX
Optionally repeat with a dn filter for the extension on the call
expect: The response includes the in-progress call (and, with the dn filter, only calls on that extension)
evidence: needs a real 3CX PBX + Client ID/Secret — not available to the design or dev leg; not a blocker per the vendor-mcp-development SOP ("no test account" rule). Execute once access is available.

text: Call participants are visible through the MCP tool
steps: With the active call from TC6 still in progress
Call 3cx_get_call_participants(dn) for the extension on that call
expect: The response lists the participants of that specific call
evidence: needs a real 3CX PBX + Client ID/Secret — same as TC6, not a blocker.

text: A call can be placed through the MCP tool
steps: Call 3cx_make_call(dn=<a real extension>, destination=<a reachable test number>) with valid headers
expect: 3CX places the call; the tool returns a participant id and a ringing/connected status; the extension is observed ringing or connecting
evidence: needs a real 3CX PBX + Client ID/Secret and a safe destination to call — not available to design or dev leg; not a blocker.

text: Given a call can be ended, When calling 3cx_drop_call without confirm: true, Then the tool returns {done: false, message: ...} and does not call the upstream drop endpoint
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_drop_call_requires_confirm -> PASSED. Without confirm:true, asserts {done: false} and that POST .../drop was never sent; with confirm:true, asserts {done: true} and exactly one POST .../drop.

text: With confirm: true, the call actually ends on the PBX
steps: Place a test call per TC8
expect: The tool returns {done: true}; the call is actually ended on the PBX
evidence: needs a real 3CX PBX + Client ID/Secret — same constraint as TC8, not a blocker.

text: Given valid credentials, When calling 3cx_list_call_history and 3cx_list_event_logs with a start/end date range, Then matching historical records are returned, paginated the same way as directory tools
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_call_history_and_event_logs_date_range -> PASSED. Asserts $filter contains the SegmentStartTime ge/le date-range clauses (plus CallerID eq for the caller filter) for both threecx_list_call_history and threecx_list_event_logs.

text: Given two interleaved requests with different X-3CX-* header sets (simulating two tenants on the same running container), When both are in flight concurrently, Then neither request's credentials, token, or response data is visible to the other (contextvar isolation, no shared cache)
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_middleware.py::test_concurrent_requests_do_not_leak_credentials_or_tokens -> PASSED. Two interleaved requests with different X-3CX-Client-Secret values never observe each other's credential in the contextvar.

text: Given the upstream 3CX API returns 429 or 5xx on a read call, Then the server retries with backoff and eventually returns a retryable upstream_error if still failing; given the same on a write call (3cx_make_call/3cx_drop_call), Then it is not auto-retried
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_read_retries_on_429_and_5xx_write_does_not and test_write_is_not_retried_on_429_either -> both PASSED. GET /xapi/v1/ActiveCalls retries once on a mocked 502 then succeeds (2 calls seen); POST .../makecall on a mocked 500 and POST .../drop on a mocked 429 are each called exactly once (no retry) and return upstream_error / rate_limited respectively.
